name: Roasted Honey-Garlic Chicken Drumsticks with Sweet Potato Wedges

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to one of the baking sheets. Drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to coat. Spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 lb chicken drumsticks
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping chicken halfway, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and cut each sweet potato lengthwise into 6-8 wedges, depending on size. Transfer to the other baking sheet, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and garlic powder. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Add sweet potatoes to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place honey, oil, soy sauce, garlic powder, and paprika in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp honey
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp soy sauce
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken and sweet potatoes are done, change the oven to broil on high. Position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Add chicken to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat. Return to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Return chicken to the oven and broil until the skin is bubbly and caramelized, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide chicken and sweet potato wedges between plates. Enjoy!
